reasoning: The question asks whether Germany's Democracy Index score will be lower in the 2025 report (published early 2026) compared to the previous report. The evidence shows concerning trends: the Deutschland-Monitor 2025/2026 reveals 20-25% of Germans are open to authoritarian ideas, 31% support a one-party system (up from 26% in 2024), only 60% are satisfied with democracy's functioning, and 71% perceive democracy declining. However, these are public opinion surveys, not the Economist's Democracy Index methodology, which measures electoral process, civil liberties, political participation, etc. Germany remains a functioning democracy with strong institutions. The Economist's index tends to be relatively stable for established democracies. While public sentiment has shifted, actual democratic backsliding in governance hasn't occurred. I estimate moderate probability of a small score decline.
